description: This PHP class defines a 'SafeEmbed' HTML module for the HTMLPurifier library, which manages the sanitization of embed elements in HTML to ensure safety against XSS and other vulnerabilities.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeEmbed
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule that adds a safe embed element with specific attributes for sanitized embedding.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the SafeEmbed module by adding an 'embed' element with restricted attributes to ensure safe embedding of multimedia content.
